steps.say: Many words ending in f or fe change to -ves in the plural.
steps.show: leaf → leaves, knife → knives, half → halves

steps.say: Some words ending in f just add -s. Say the plural aloud to check.
Words ending in a consonant and y change to -ies.
Some words change inside, or become a new word.
steps.show: child → children, mouse → mice, foot → feet

steps.say: A few words do not change at all.
steps.show: one sheep, two sheep; one fish, two fish

steps.say: Some words ending in o add -es.

options.why: Wolf changes its f to v.
The f must change to v before -es.
